sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 21 April 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000143-P1 was put before Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 143 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 2 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 720 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
